siddharthanagar-001.en: I took the night bus to Pokhara.

siddharthanagar-008.ko: 국경 문 앞 길에서 아이들이 전통 옷을 입고 춤을 췄습니다.
siddharthanagar-008.en: On the road by the border gate, kids in traditional dress were dancing.

siddharthanagar-010.ko: 새벽 국경 마을 위에 뜬 달
siddharthanagar-010.en: The moon over the border town before dawn

siddharthanagar-011.en: Before dawn I got off in the border town.

siddharthanagar-012.en: It was my first night in Nepal.
